title: zygopetalum guttatum

It is a terrestrial orchid that contains various bioactive compounds with potential health benefits, including the ability to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health due to its flavonoid and alkaloid constituents. The therapeutic actions of Zygopetalum guttatum are thought to be attributed to its flavonoids and alkaloids, which may have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
